rows.grounds: compound of prāñc and mukha, accusative singular neuter
causative optative third singular of sthā

items.question: How should the son be positioned relative to the husband during the naming rite?
premises: the son is placed facing east
the naming rite occurs in the sixth or eighth month
items.inference: The son is to be placed facing east after approaching the husband's side.
uncertainties: whether prāṅmukhaṃ modifies the son or the placement direction
items.plain_english: Having approached the husband's side, one should place the son facing east.
